reading.title: The Library Clue Challenge
reading.purpose: Follow two classmates as they decode clues and organize evidence for a library mystery game.
paras: Every spring, Ms. Grant hosted a mystery challenge in the school library. She handed Nadia and Theo a sealed folder and smiled. "Let me pose a question for you," she said, putting forward their task. "Which animal in our display case moved overnight?"
Nadia opened the folder and began to examine the three clue cards closely. "First, we should organize these slips in order," Theo suggested. He laid them out by time of day so the plan made sense.

Card one had a coded note made of numbers. Together they worked to decode the secret message, matching each number to a letter until it spelled "OWL." Nadia grabbed a sticky note to annotate the card, jotting short notes along the edge to track her thinking.

Next, they had to distinguish between two stuffed birds in the case, telling how the barn owl differed from the horned owl. "Let's quote the exact words from card two," Theo said, reading aloud: "White heart-shaped face." Nadia began to restate that clue in her own words. "That means it is the barn owl!"

Then Nadia tried to relate card three to the librarian's desk, showing how the feather clue connected to the return bin. To extend their search further, they checked behind the atlas shelf and found a paper cutout of the barn owl grinning back at them.
